nazwa_en: Faculty of Social Sciences, University of Szczecin
opis: Profil importów WNS (v50). Szkice planów robi parser plan-bm (scripts/us/wns-pdf.mjs) i wysyła je do kolejki nauka_import_szkic_automat; ten sam profil działa dla PDF-u wgranego ręcznie (szkic AI).

plan.polecenie:
Each item is ONE class in the weekly timetable of one year of study. Two layouts: (A) day columns with sub-columns "Grupa 1/2" and time rows on the left; (B) one table per weekday (day name above the table), time columns ("8.15 – 9.45" …), rows = year (Rok I, II …) and groups ("BN-SI.26-11", "1 BP", "1 ćw", "2 lab").
d = weekday: 0 Monday … 4 Friday. od/do = the time written in the cell ("Godz. 9.00-11.30") or the time slots the cell covers.
pg = the group the cell is for: "gr:11", "ćw:1", "lab:3", "spec:BP"; "" when for the whole year.
r = room with building: "s. 40/O" → "s. 40 ul. Ogińskiego 16-17", "s. 026/K" → "s. 026 ul. Krakowska 71-79", other rooms as printed.
Dates are written with Roman months: "Od 6X do 24 XI" = every week between, "5,12,19 X; 7 XII" = those days.
grupa = the year group code given in the task (e.g. SOC1); tydzien = oba.
k = W (wykład, lecture), CW (ćwiczenia, exercises, lektorat, warsztaty), K (konwersatorium), S (seminarium), LAB (laboratorium), X (other).
p = teachers as printed; daty = dates as YYYY-MM-DD (October–December 2026, January–February 2027), [] when the class is every week.
en = "", g = "", n = notes (exceptions such as "ostatnie zajęcia w godz. …") or "".

przyklady.n: zajęcia dn. 24.XI trwają 1 godz. w godzinach 8.15 - 9.00
